name: soul-launcher
description: Soul Launcher - a fast, lightweight Minecraft launcher

scripts.dist: npm run build && tauri build && npm run dist:copy || npm run dist:copy
scripts.dist:copy: node -e "const{copyFileSync,readdirSync,statSync,mkdirSync,existsSync}=require('fs');const{join}=require('path');const out='target/release/bundle/nsis';const rel='release';if(!existsSync(rel))mkdirSync(rel,{recursive:true});const fs=readdirSync(out).filter(f=>f.endsWith('-setup.exe')).sort((a,b)=>statSync(join(out,b)).mtimeMs-statSync(join(out,a)).mtimeMs);if(!fs.length){console.error('NSIS installer not found in '+out);process.exit(1)}copyFileSync(join(out,fs[0]),join(rel,'setup.exe'));console.log('wrote release/setup.exe from '+fs[0])"
